adjudication.rationale: In GoogleCalendarService.refreshAccessToken, `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` assigns the *safeParse result object* (with `{ success, data, error }`) to `key`, and then persists it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. `parseRefreshTokenResponse` (new file) explicitly returns `schema.safeParse(...)` / `minimumTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(...)`, not the parsed `.data`, so this would store the wrapper rather than the credential payload. Also, it is passed `googleCredentials` (the local credentials object) rather than the refresh response body (`res.data`), so it is not validating the refresh response itself per the finding.
